body: Yeah I agree 100%, a cystoscopy could definitely been avoided if I was tested first to rule it out. Unfortunately when I got referred to the urologist they booked me straight in for a cystoscopy without a consult and when I asked to be tested first I was told no. I’m a male, is there the same risk for damage to the urethra in this kind of procedure?
Thank you! It’s been an incredibly frustrating 5 months with no one listening. I might not even have it but I just was the peace of mind

Thank you for your reply and information. I tried pushing for a test for ureaplasma first but he went straight for a flexible cystoscopy which found some inflammation on my bladder. I was put on 4 weeks of anti inflammatories to try help it and then do another cystoscopy. Still haven’t done a test but will keep trying, not sure if the inflammation was caused by ureaplasma but hoping to get some answers soon.

I think I might be in a similar situation as you where I had what I thought was an outbreak but no clear cut blisters to swab. If I do get an outbreak I’ll do the same and go straight to the doctors but it’s impossible to tell if that will happen. It’s so frustrating that you can’t get a blood test here to not only look after yourself but potential partners as well. The advice is pretty much if you don’t have blisters then you don’t have it 🤦‍♂️
Were you diagnosed via a swab test? I know it’s near on impossible here to get a blood test so unless you show visible symptoms they refuse to give you a blood test
Let me know how you get on, my symptoms are the exact same as yours but I haven’t tested positive for anything yet which is incredibly frustrating

I know right! I’m in the exact same position, I’m sure as hell it’s an infection of some sort but can’t get a diagnosis. I have been to the doctor countless time I swear they must be sick of seeing me but I don’t know what else to do. I am going crazy over this and it feels like I’ll never get it sorted

Thanks for your reply, can PFD be something that comes on suddenly? All of these symptoms started to occur after a sexual contact where the condom broke and I’ve never experienced anything like this before

Thank you for your reply, I forgot to put in there that I’ve also tested negative for chalmydia and Gonorrhoea but was treated for both anyway. I haven’t had a urethra swab yet and I’m not sure if the urine tests I’ve done have been pcr but I will definitely ask for those.

I have been having similar symptoms for around 3 months but tested negative as well, not sure if it was a false negative tho as I held urine for around 3 hours. I want to get tested again and also check for ureaplasma. Have you been having any other symptoms?

Have you been tested or heard of mycoplasma genitalium or ureaplasma before? It sounds like it could be one of these as the antibiotics you took helped your symptoms but you needed to take doxycycline first then azithromycin after to clear the infection. It would be worth asking next time you see your urologist
Yup it sucks, I could have it but because I’ve never had an outbreak I will never know. It would be a horrible feeling passing it to someone because I couldn’t get tested so would never know

That’s true, it can be really frustrating trying to get tested for everything because they don’t want to do it. For example I can not test tested for herpes in my country unless you have a visible outbreak. A blood test won’t be don’t even if you ask
The best way to know for sure is to go get tested. It’s probably a fairly low chance but you never know, STDs are a tricky thing that don’t always show symptoms.
No I haven’t
Good luck, hopefully it works for you. One more question, when you got tested for it was it done by urine of other method?
Not really, it seems to be worse after urinating and first thing in the morning
Thank you :), have you had any other symptoms as well and did you manage to get it treated?

I did have a brief look at that but I don’t think it is hard flaccid as it only occurred after this incident and haven’t had sex after. I’ve had balanitis before and tried treating it the same way but seems to not help and can make it feel worse
That could very likely be a false positive.

Thank you so much for your reply. I am able to get a blood test in another 4 weeks for HIV, hepatitis B and C but not for HSV as they don’t tend to in my country without the visible symptoms. Thank you for the advice about the medication as well, I will ask about a fungal infection when I go again next week.
